summary: Tested drag-and-drop functionality from Add-On List to Calendar. Fixed backend PUT /api/schedules/{id} endpoint to support partial updates (was returning 422 due to required fields). All 6 drag-and-drop features now working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing add-on patients (Emily Chen, Francois, Test Patient 562337, Test Add-On Patient) for drag-and-drop testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drag-and-drop from Add-On List to Calendar is fully functional. Backend was fixed to support partial updates via PUT /api/schedules/{id}. All 6 features tested and passing.

addon_items_draggable.details: Add-on items have cursor-grab class, active:cursor-grabbing class, and GripVertical drag handle icon

week_view_drop_targets.details: 7 calendar day drop targets found with data-testid='calendar-day-drop-{date}'

month_view_drop_targets.details: 28 calendar day drop targets found with data-testid='calendar-month-day-{date}'

drag_drop_schedules_patient.details: Successfully dragged Emily Chen to Feb 22 (week view) and Francois to Feb 25 (month view). Patients removed from add-on list and appeared on calendar.

toast_notification.details: Toast notifications appeared: 'Emily Chen scheduled for February 22, 2026' and 'Francois scheduled for February 25, 2026'

visual_feedback_during_drag.details: Code implements: opacity-50/scale-95/ring-2 for dragged item, ring-2/bg-orange-50/scale-[1.02] for drop target, 'Drop here' text on active target

bug_fix_applied.issue: PUT /api/schedules/{id} was returning 422 Unprocessable Entity because it required all Schedule fields
bug_fix_applied.fix: Created SchedulePartialUpdate model with all optional fields and updated PUT endpoint to only update provided fields
